practice.title: Sensitivity check: Buildroot
steps: Solve one baseline case for Buildroot and record every input you assumed.
Vary the two most influential inputs and re-solve.
Report how sensitive the result is, and the design margin you would recommend.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on Buildroot for Embedded Linux. Finish it by checking that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply Buildroot
projects.description: Apply Buildroot for Embedded Linux and produce a schematic and its simulated or measured results. Then check that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of Buildroot by producing a schematic and its simulated or measured results and verifying that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.
requirements: A schematic and its simulated or measured results that genuinely applies Buildroot for Embedded Linux.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.
outcomes: Working schematic, plots, and a test/measurement log.
A short written explanation of Buildroot you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
